description: Experience sampling, 8 prompts a day between 09:00 and 21:00 for 5 working days, 77 Dutch undergraduate students: seven bipolar mood items after 'At this moment, I feel:' (tired-awake, content-discontent, agitated-calm, full of energy-without energy, unwell-well, relaxed-tense, depressed-happy). 1..7; discontent, without_energy and tense run towards the negative pole.
reference: Johannes, N., Meier, A., Reinecke, L., Ehlert, S., Setiawan, D. N., Walasek, N., Dienlin, T., Buijzen, M., & Veling, H. (2021). The relationship between online vigilance and affective well-being in everyday life: Combining smartphone logging with experience sampling. Media Psychology, 24(5), 581-605.
notes: Processed from the openESM harmonised copy (0051_johannes, 10.5281/zenodo.22953104); original deposit https://osf.io/ps3rk/files, also CC BY 4.0. One participant (id 66 in openESM's copy) is excluded: a technical fault sent them 69 prompts, 11 to 16 a day and often under the study's 45-minute minimum spacing, and the authors judged those data untrustworthy. The participant the paper excluded for answering too few surveys is kept. See data/johannes_2021_mood_esm.py.
